newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-ACESITA STILL A HOLD.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-ACESITA STILL A HOLD.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it had reiterated its hold rating on Brazilian private steelmaker Acesita.
-- The report followed the release of the company's second quarter earnings of $16.5 million or $0.09 per share, against a net loss of $6.2 million in the same period a year ago.
-- Earnings for the first half of 1997 reached $38.7 million, against a net loss of $29.9 million in the same period last year.
-- Salomon said Acesita's improved second quarter performance was mostly due to three factors:
* increase in gross margin in the second quarter to 18 percent from 8.2 percent a year ago, reflecting stability in raw material prices, and improved operational efficiency.
* Steelmaker Companhia Siderurgica de Tubarao (CST) was the major contributor to equity income. Acesita acquired a 34 percent stake in CST last year.
- Acesita preferred was down 2.0 percent at 2.45 reais earlier on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
